headline: Nigeria: UBA raises its operating income to 1.22 billion USD
summary: United Bank for Africa posted operating income of 1.67 trillion naira ($1.22 billion) for the first nine months of 2026, up 12.7% year on year, though after-tax profit fell.
why: United Bank for Africa is a major Nigerian lender with pan-African operations, and its results indicate the health of the region's banking sector.
original_headline: Nigeria : UBA porte son résultat opérationnel à 1,22 milliard USD
